crawl.effective_selection_instructions:
Collect all useful source pages for these four areas:
1. Contact information: contact pages, office addresses, email, phone and profile links.
2. Jobs: careers listings and full job descriptions, including the target employer's
   external job board and its individual ads. Collect all useful job pages within budget.
3. About the company: identity, activities, products and services that describe what
   the company does. Include useful service/product detail pages as well as overviews.
4. Financial information: investor relations, financial statements, annual reports
   and filings. Find the pages linking to these documents; document links are saved
   without downloading the documents.
Choose pages for their source content only. Do not analyze jobs, infer skills or
technology usage, or seek technology-stack evidence. Skip engineering blogs,
tutorials, employee stories and news unless they directly provide the requested
company or financial information. Preserve job descriptions even when they mention
technologies; interpretation belongs to later offline processing.

site_info.site_description: AcadeMedia is a Swedish education company whose corporate site presents its operations and schools. It states that it runs preschools, compulsory schools, upper secondary schools and adult education programmes in Sweden and Europe. The site describes operations across the whole education chain, from preschool to adult education, including international activities, and says the company develops, operates and invests in digital education services and technologies. It also publishes news and opinion material about the company and the Swedish school system, provides contact details and investor information, and advertises job openings.
site_info.purpose: Corporate website of an education provider presenting its schools, education offerings and company information.
business_activities: Adult education and vocational higher education

Debatt: Kritiserar man AcadeMedia måste fakta stämma
AcadeMedias opinionschef Katariina Treville skriver en kommentar till ett debattinlägg i Västmanlands Läns Tidning där hon menar att om AcadeMedia s...
Läsförmåga, läsning och demokrati är de övergripande temana för AcadeMedia under årets Bokmässa. För i grunden hänger frågorna ihop. Att lära ett ba...
Även detta läsår välkomnar AcadeMedias gymnasieskolor allt fler elever, både totalt sett och till årskurs 1, samtidigt som andelen elever som når gy...
Vi finns i hela utbildningskedjan –
från förskola till vuxenutbildning.
Förutom våra verksamheter i Sverige så driver vi även förskolor, skolor och utbildningar utomlands.
Vi utvecklar, driver och investerar i digitala utbildningstjänster och teknologier för att utveckla morgondagens lärande och skola.
Svar på vanliga frågor om oss och om det svenska skolsystemet.
